actions.name: Use
actions.area: creatures within a 30-ft.-radius spread centered on caster

description.summary: The caster emulates Whiskerwall Kupdi Koop by summoning a shield and spinning it at great speed around them
description.value: The caster emulates Whiskerwall Kupdi Koop by summoning a shield and spinning it at great speed around them. All creatures caught within the area of effect take 3d6 points of bludgeoning damage, a Reflex save for half damage. Those failing the Reflex save must make a Fortitude save or be stunned for 1d4 rounds. Learned From Whiskerwall Kupdi Koop & Good King Moggle Mog XII
